## Checklist

- [ ] My commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the [DCO](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin-dco).
- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] I rebuilt and tested the affected component(s) locally.
- [ ] I added/updated tests where it makes sense.
- [ ] I updated documentation (README / `docs/`) for any behavior change.
- [ ] For API model changes, I added an EF Core migration via `dotnet ef migrations add` (no hand-edited migration files).
- [ ] For UI changes, `npm run lint` passes and new strings are internationalized (en + fr).
